up: Return the first 1000 activity rows meeting the following criteria. The rows must be from assays associated with the target CHEMBL1919 (Voltage-dependent calcium channel subunit alpha-2/delta-1). The target type must be 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and the organism must be 'Homo sapiens' (tax_id 9606). The activity rows must have an exact standard relation '=' and a non-null pChEMBL value. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1919'), filtered_activities AS (SELECT a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target) AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL) SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, fa.standard_type, fa.pchembl_value FROM filtered_activities fa JOIN assays ass ON fa.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON fa.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON fa.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
